requirements.requirement: Define the exact production responsibility of Bulk data plane.
Document what Bulk data plane owns and explicitly does not own.
Identify upstream, downstream, and peer dependencies of Bulk data plane.
requirements.note: Upstream/downstream/peer dependencies are listed, though not integration-tested.

requirements.requirement: Define the authoritative source of truth used by Bulk data plane.
requirements.note: Manifest recomputation is named as source of truth.

requirements.requirement: Document assumptions Bulk data plane makes about nodes, runtimes, networks, storage, and control planes.
Define tenant, environment, site, and workload boundaries relevant to Bulk data plane.
requirements.note: Tenant/environment/site/workload boundaries are declared in the contract.

requirements.requirement: Separate mandatory Bulk data plane capabilities from optional optimizations.
requirements.note: Mandatory versus optional capabilities are separated.

requirements.requirement: Document unsupported deployment patterns and non-goals for Bulk data plane.
Assign an accountable owner and escalation path for Bulk data plane.
requirements.note: Open: Name people for all 5 roles; run and record escalation tabletop; bind CODEOWNERS handles to real groups.

requirements.requirement: Approve an architecture decision record for Bulk data plane, its technologies (Zero-copy shared memory), and its function (Avoid repeated host/guest copies).
requirements.note: Open: architecture_approver approval; phase-2 host/guest ADR (virtio/vhost-user).

requirements.requirement: Translate the source function of Bulk data plane — Avoid repeated host/guest copies — into testable SHALL-level requirements.
requirements.note: Open: SHALLs for the host/guest path cannot be verified until that path exists.

requirements.requirement: Define functional requirements for Bulk data plane across cloud, datacenter, near-edge, and far-edge contexts where applicable.
requirements.note: Open: CI/lab conformance runs on each claimed context (near/far-edge hardware, cross-host).

requirements.requirement: Define non-functional requirements for latency, availability, durability, consistency, isolation, or determinism as applicable.
requirements.note: Open: Approval of proposed numbers; production-hardware evidence.

requirements.requirement: Define success, partial success, degraded operation, retryable failure, and terminal failure semantics for Bulk data plane.
Define lifecycle states and legal state transitions managed or exposed by Bulk data plane.
Define versioning and backward-compatibility requirements for Bulk data plane.
Define capacity ceilings, quotas, and fairness semantics relevant to Bulk data plane.
Define behavior when network connectivity is intermittent or absent.
Define precedence rules when Bulk data plane requirements conflict with security, residency, SLO, or cost constraints.
Maintain a requirements traceability matrix from each Bulk data plane requirement to implementation and verification evidence.
requirements.note: TRACEABILITY.md maps every checklist requirement to evidence/status.

requirements.requirement: Enumerate every API, WIT contract, RPC, event, file, device, hypervisor, or control-plane boundary exposed by Bulk data plane.
Use versioned typed schemas for all externally visible Bulk data plane contracts.
requirements.note: Versioned JSON Schemas are supplied for manifest, chunk, and resume contracts.

requirements.requirement: Define authentication requirements at each Bulk data plane boundary.
requirements.note: Open: mTLS/SPIFFE/attested node identity for cross-process/host boundaries.

requirements.requirement: Define authorization and explicit capability requirements at each Bulk data plane boundary.
Define timeout, cancellation, retry, idempotency, and backpressure semantics for Bulk data plane.
Define structured failure codes and machine-readable error details for Bulk data plane.
requirements.note: Stable structured error codes/details are implemented in errors.py.

requirements.requirement: Define compatibility behavior when peers use different supported versions.
Document payload, concurrency, queue, connection, or resource limits at Bulk data plane interfaces.
Provide reference examples and conformance fixtures for Bulk data plane.
Create automated integration tests proving Bulk data plane interoperates with adjacent architectural layers.
requirements.note: Open: Real INV-36/GAP-14/PLN-06/INV-38, identity service and VM topology.

requirements.requirement: Select and pin approved implementations, versions, or specifications for Bulk data plane: Zero-copy shared memory.
requirements.note: Open: Host/guest implementation and its drivers/binaries with checksums; approval.

requirements.requirement: Separate immutable artifacts from mutable configuration and state for Bulk data plane.
Define declarative configuration and secure defaults for Bulk data plane.
Validate configuration before activation and fail closed on security-critical errors.
Support site- and environment-specific configuration without rebuilding immutable artifacts.
Record configuration provenance, version, author, and activation time.
Apply atomic or transactional configuration updates where partial application is unsafe.
Define automatic and operator-driven rollback for failed Bulk data plane changes.
Keep credentials and secret material out of ordinary Bulk data plane configuration and diagnostics.
Provide a deterministic bootstrap path from an empty node/environment to healthy Bulk data plane operation.
Threat-model Bulk data plane against malicious tenants, compromised workloads, hostile inputs, supply-chain compromise, and control-plane abuse.
Apply least privilege to every identity and capability used by Bulk data plane.
Eliminate ambient filesystem, network, device, kernel, and secret authority wherever Bulk data plane permits.
Authenticate nodes, peers, artifacts, providers, and control-plane actors before trust is granted.
requirements.note: Open: Node attestation, provider authentication, signed artifacts.

requirements.requirement: Verify signatures, digests, provenance, and approved versions for executable or policy artifacts consumed by Bulk data plane.
Enforce tenant/workload isolation across Bulk data plane execution, memory, state, network, and device boundaries as applicable.
requirements.note: Open: OS-level isolation (UID/IPC namespaces), side-channel review.

requirements.requirement: Encrypt sensitive Bulk data plane data in transit and at rest with managed key rotation.
requirements.note: Open: Select, pin and integrate an AEAD provider with key rotation; transport encryption.

requirements.requirement: Define safe behavior when identity, attestation, policy, key, or time services are unavailable.
requirements.note: Open: Attestation service does not exist yet, so its outage behaviour is specified only on paper; accountable-role review.

requirements.requirement: Emit tamper-evident audit events for security-sensitive Bulk data plane operations.
Run adversarial tests for privilege escalation, injection, replay, spoofing, escape, side channels, and resource exhaustion.
requirements.note: Open: Escape/side-channel testing and independent penetration test.

requirements.requirement: Enumerate component, process, VM, node, site, network, provider, dependency, and control-plane failures affecting Bulk data plane.
Define automated health and stall detection thresholds for Bulk data plane.
Implement bounded retry with backoff and jitter only where operations are safe to retry.
Implement admission control, load shedding, or circuit breaking to prevent Bulk data plane failure cascades.
requirements.note: BoundedTransferPool implements fail-closed admission control and saturation metrics.

requirements.requirement: Define failover behavior without violating isolation, residency, or consistency requirements.
requirements.note: Open: Multi-node takeover drill on shared/reattached storage.

requirements.requirement: Provide degraded operation when noncritical dependencies are unavailable.
Define crash-consistency, restart, resume, or replay semantics for mutable Bulk data plane state.
Protect against split-brain, duplicate ownership, stale controllers, or duplicate execution where relevant.
Provide quarantine, freeze, disable, or isolation controls for unsafe Bulk data plane behavior.
Run fault-injection tests proving Bulk data plane recovery against documented objectives.
Establish reproducible baselines for Bulk data plane latency, throughput, startup, CPU, memory, storage, network, and power overhead.
Define p50, p95, p99, and worst-case performance thresholds for Bulk data plane.
requirements.note: Open: Approval of thresholds on production hardware.

requirements.requirement: Measure Bulk data plane under steady load, burst load, overload, scale-out, scale-in, and recovery.
requirements.note: Open: Soak, fleet scale-out/scale-in on real deployment.

requirements.requirement: Measure per-workload and per-tenant overhead introduced by Bulk data plane.
requirements.note: Open: Per-workload overhead inside real embedding services.

requirements.requirement: Identify avoidable serialization, copies, context switches, network hops, duplicated images, or duplicated state in Bulk data plane.
requirements.note: ADR-0001 explicitly identifies receiver copies/final assembly copies and the zero-copy gap.

requirements.requirement: Apply locality, caching, direct composition, batching, zero-copy, or kernel-bypass optimizations where semantics permit.
requirements.note: Open: Host/guest zero-copy; kernel bypass belongs to INV-38.

requirements.requirement: Bound memory growth, queue depth, buffer size, concurrency, and resource fan-out.
Measure power and thermal impact on constrained edge nodes where relevant.
requirements.note: Open: Measure power/thermal on target edge hardware.

requirements.requirement: Define capacity models and saturation signals that predict when Bulk data plane needs more resources.
Block releases that regress approved Bulk data plane startup, density, throughput, or tail-latency thresholds.
requirements.note: Open: Thresholds are proposed, not approved; production-hardware baseline.

requirements.requirement: Expose Bulk data plane health, readiness, version, configuration, dependency status, and active capability set.
Emit structured metrics for rate, errors, latency, saturation, backlog, and resource use.
Emit structured logs with stable node, tenant, workload, component, and operation identifiers.
Propagate trace context across all relevant Bulk data plane boundaries.
requirements.note: Open: Propagation across INV-36/INV-38 and exporter integration.

requirements.requirement: Expose high-cardinality diagnostic detail safely without leaking tenant or secret data.
Record the reason for every automated decision made by Bulk data plane.
Provide an operator-readable explain view linking decisions to input state, policies, topology, and constraints.
Correlate Bulk data plane events with application release lineage and the live infrastructure graph.
Define telemetry retention, sampling, privacy, and export policy.
Create dashboards and alerts distinguishing ordinary load, degradation, policy rejection, dependency failure, attack, and software defect.
requirements.note: Open: Deploy and validate under live failure/load.

Create integration tests with every supported adjacent layer and execution tier.

Fuzz parsers, schemas, protocol handlers, WIT/RPC boundaries, or untrusted inputs handled by Bulk data plane.

Create security tests derived directly from the Bulk data plane threat model.
Create benchmark, soak, burst, and fleet-scale tests appropriate to Bulk data plane.

Perform recurring access, policy, dependency, configuration, and architecture reviews.
